name: Delivery Issue Triage: melted, damaged and missing orders

parameters.content:
## 1. Check and save the message
The help form or email parser posts each message with the shared secret in the `X-Support-Secret` header. A wrong or missing secret gets 401, bad fields get 400, and with no secret configured every message gets 503 and you get an alert (fail closed). A message ID that is already in Tickets is answered as a duplicate and nothing else runs. A new message is saved as the next ticket (T-0005, T-0006 and so on) before the sender gets 200, so nothing is lost. If Airtable does not answer, the sender gets 503 with Retry-After and you get an alert.

## 2. Classify with Claude
A one second pause keeps Airtable under 5 requests per second. Then one forced tool call returns the issue type, the order number, the sentiment, a safety flag and a one line summary. Claude only classifies. If it fails 3 times or answers without the tool call, the message is sorted by keywords and always goes to a person.

## 3. Order and claim history
Finds the order by number and compares its email with the sender, finds the customer by email, and lists earlier approved replacements for this email and for this order. If Airtable answers 429 (another automation used up the 5 requests per second), the workflow waits 35 seconds once and looks again. Any other failure leaves the ticket at New and you get an alert.

## 4. Rules
Melted within CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS, with a warm forecast and no cold pack or a late delivery: free replacement. Damaged or wrong item: photo request. In transit and not late: tracking. No order number: ask for it. Allergy questions, safety concerns, repeat claimants and anything else: a person.

## 5. Free replacement in Shopify
Reads the original order and, in the same request, looks for a draft already tagged replacement-for-<order>, so a later message about the same order gets no second replacement. Creates a draft order with the same lines at a 100 percent discount and free shipping. Shopify may still be calculating a new draft (`ready` is false): the workflow checks again every 2 seconds, up to 3 times, and completes the draft only when it is ready and its total is 0. Any failure sends the ticket to a person with High priority, and no approval email goes out.

## 6. Reply, alert and log
Postmark sends the email for the automatic outcomes. Tickets for a person get a Slack alert instead, with the customer text escaped. If the email fails, the ticket goes to a person. One Airtable update then writes the outcome and the full Action Log. A 429 there waits 35 seconds once and tries again; if the update still fails, the alert carries the outcome so it can be entered by hand.
